scope.identity_basis: User-provided device diagnostic identity and previously saved metadata; no live device verification in this review. Official product/manual identify model 2565RT, not HWID 1352.

conclusion.summary: Official Garmin material establishes computer-facing USB device/storage use and dedicated mount power/camera connections. It does not establish a generic USB host role, VBUS output or AOA on this exact board. An OTG-capable chip or a dedicated camera connector cannot close those board-level gaps.

supports.claim: Manual applicability includes 2555/2565T/2565RT Traditional Chinese software Ver 2.00 and above; feature changes are possible.

Power cable plugs into mount miniUSB so mount supplies power to navigation unit; this documents power INPUT.
GDR10 transmission cable connects to mount-side microUSB; this documents a DEDICATED accessory connection.
Computer connection uses USB cable. Normal and flash-drive modes are offered; flash-drive use supports Mass Storage Device Class and exposes internal memory/microSD as removable drives.
